I have an experiment of TMTpro 16 plex in 4 runs with 58 samples + 6 (internal control). The experiment was fractionated in gradient length (table and experiment information attached).

messages.author: 5c6e92c10ef28984
messages.subject: Re: Fraction variable in PD annotation
parts:
Hi,


after preprocessing with our PD converter, MSstats will consider a combination of (Mixture, TechRepMixture) as a Run, so all runs within a given combination of  these columns are be considered fractions. However, we use the Fraction column (not the Run column) so it is required. It can be identical to Run column.

Kind regards
Mateusz
